verdict.rationale: Skyvern's core model is exactly this story. You give it a natural-language prompt and a starting URL, and it drives a real browser through sites it has never seen: navigating, filling forms, logging in, and completing multi-step tasks. It is exposed to developers through the SDK and the REST API (POST /v1/run/tasks). Hands-on community testing confirms it does well on the happy path (the Geico example). However, the same tester saw it fail to click a tab and a popup on a more complex site (costcotravel.com), which tempers confidence in its reliability on hard flows. Missing for 10: consistent reliability on complex, popup-heavy multi-step flows, and broader independent corroboration of end-to-end success rates.
